claims.claim: These 2 books are perfect combo for intentional people, who don't just want to be at the top but...
claims.evidence: The report confirms the two titles exist but cannot verify subjective suitability or complete the seller's thought.

risks.risk: Pages are marked, dirty, or contain writing or highlighting.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of page edges and several interior pages, or a flip-through video.
risks.if_unproven: priced as pages marked or written in.

risks.risk: Publication year or edition is older or less desirable.
risks.proof: Photo of the copyright/title page inside each book.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the oldest available edition.

risks.risk: Spine and binding are worn or damaged.
risks.proof: Photos of both spines and the books opened to show binding.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn or damaged binding.

risks.risk: Dust jackets are missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo showing the full covers and any dust jackets.

risks.risk: Books are sold individually rather than as a pair.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation or photo showing both as a single lot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as separate books, not a set.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the inside pages of both books to check for marks, highlighting, or writing.
Photos of the copyright pages to confirm edition and year.
Photos of the spines and bindings.
Confirmation whether the two books are sold as a pair.
response.reason: The witness identifies two specific paperback books, so a worst-case price is possible; condition and edition risks are listed with the proof needed to raise the value.
